guidance.sentence: FY 2026 Adjusted EBITDA Outlook is now expected to be in the range of $5.05 billion to $5.20 billion, a $195 million increase at the midpoint of the range; FY 2026 Adjusted Free Cash Flow outlook now expected to be in the range of $2.825 billion to $3.125 billion, a $100 million increase

FY 2026 Adjusted EBITDA Outlook is now expected to be in the range of $5.05 billion to $5.20 billion, a $195 million increase at the midpoint of the range; FY 2026 Adjusted Free Cash Flow outlook now expected to be in the range of $2.825 billion to $3.125 billion, a $100 million increase

These are timing-related adjustments and as such, do not impact total or full year 2026 expectations for revenue from contract termination or net operating revenues associated with the RCM Agreements.

summary: Tenet raised its FY 2026 outlook, now expecting Adjusted EBITDA of $5.05 billion to $5.20 billion and Adjusted Free Cash Flow of $2.825 billion to $3.125 billion, and said the RCM-related catch-up adjustments do not change its full-year 2026 revenue expectations.
